Q9033.reason: VCLT Article 31 requires good-faith interpretation by ordinary meaning in context and in light of object and purpose; preparatory works are only supplementary under Article 32.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is an overgrown firm mass of scar tissue extending beyond the original wound, not a fine hairline scar or a drain-related complication.

Q9037.reason: A standard indication for tracheostomy is prolonged ventilation and assistance with weaning; it does not repair paralyzed vocal cords.
